question: Could you calculate the average of the total runs scored by all strikers who have scored more than 50 runs in any single match?
sql:
WITH runs_per_striker_per_match AS (
    SELECT 
        b.match_id,
        b.striker,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND b.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
        AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE b.striker = b.striker
    GROUP BY b.match_id, b.striker
),
strikers_with_50_plus AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT striker
    FROM runs_per_striker_per_match
    WHERE total_runs > 50
),
total_runs_per_striker AS (
    SELECT 
        rs.striker,
        SUM(rs.total_runs) as total_runs_all_matches
    FROM runs_per_striker_per_match rs
    JOIN strikers_with_50_plus sw ON rs.striker = sw.striker
    GROUP BY rs.striker
)
SELECT AVG(total_runs_all_matches) as average_total_runs
FROM total_runs_per_striker;
